name: agent-coexist-git
description: Git-install entry point: lets `npx github:RatmmmhSquishyRat/agent-coexist` work. npm cannot read a package.json from a subdirectory of a git repository, so this file sits at the root and points at the real wrapper in packaging/npm/, which is also what gets published to the registry. Marked private so it can never be published by mistake.
